remove_char_settings_d:
Strips certain characters from parts of equations.
Example: 5kmh*8h -> 5*8
green_dot_settings_h: Hide the green dot in the top left corner
green_dot_settings_d: Hides the little green dot in the top left corner letting you know that Latexicus loaded successfully
equals_remove_settings_d: Changes how the program handles the equals (=) sign in statements.
support_email: Email me at latexicus@ctih1.fi to report any issues! :3
notification_sincos_error: Detected sin/cos/tan without parenthesis. This may produce unexpected results
caveat_beta: Latexicus is in beta, and may produce mistakes. Report these!
caveat_tested: Latexicus has only been tested with Nova and Sanomapro's LaTeX implementations.
send_error_button_clarification: No sign-in required, report will be sent anonymously.
hide_error_prompt_d: Hides the small error reporting box at the bottom of the screen.
